---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for Manta Products
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ArvidDeJong
---

## ✨ Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the desired feature.

## 🎯 Problem/Use Case
Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it would support.

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it.**
A clear description of what the problem is. E.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 💻 Code Example (optional)
```php
// How would you like the API to look?
$product->someNewMethod([
    'option' => 'value'
]);
```

## 📊 Impact
- **Users who benefit**: [e.g. all users, enterprise users only]
- **Frequency of use**: [e.g. daily, weekly, monthly]
- **Priority**: [e.g. high, medium, low]

## 🔧 Implementation Considerations
- Are there breaking changes?
- Does it impact performance?
- Are new dependencies needed?

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have checked that this feature doesn't already exist
- [ ] I have checked that this hasn't been suggested before
- [ ] I have consulted the documentation
- [ ] This feature fits within the scope of the package
